outcome: Rates of pharmacologic prophylaxis for VTE
cohort: 293 patients on post-operative day 1 after cesarean delivery at a tertiary referral hospital.
finding: Significantly different rates of post-cesarean pharmacologic VTE prophylaxis would be recommended depending on whether RCOG, ACOG, or Chest guidelines were followed.
mod_finding: The study examined the rates of pharmacologic prophylaxis for venous thromboembolism after cesarean delivery based on different guidelines.
